categories.name: Crosshair placement
categories.principle: The crosshair sits at head height on the next corner an enemy could appear from.

checks.check: Crosshair is at head height of the nearest corner, not on the floor or sky.
checks.common_mistake: Aiming at the ground while moving.
checks.fix: Pre-aim the corner you are about to clear before you reach it.

checks.check: Crosshair is on the next uncleared angle, not on a cleared or empty area.
checks.common_mistake: Looking at the wall or teammate while walking.
checks.fix: Move the crosshair to the next danger point as you move.

categories.name: Utility usage
categories.principle: Utility is used before contact to create the fight you want, and saved when it has no purpose.

checks.check: Ability icons are still lit at the moment of death.
checks.common_mistake: Dying with flash, dash or smoke unused.
checks.fix: Use utility before peeking, not after taking damage.

rank_expectations.iron_bronze: Crosshair placement, not running while shooting, buying with the team.
rank_expectations.silver_gold: Using utility before peeking, trading with a teammate, not over-peeking after a kill.
rank_expectations.platinum_diamond: Timing, info denial, economy discipline, post-plant positioning.
rank_expectations.ascendant_plus: Round-level decision making, tempo, map control trades.
